text:
alex: FYI change window tonight 23:00 UTC for cross-service rollout. Need API/runtime/console/router coordination. Reply with ack if youre onwatch.

alex: Plan summary: runtime -> v2.4.1 (pin), api -> v1.8.0, console -> 3.2.0 (schema pinned), router -> enable header-split gated. Canary then staged ramp.

maria: ack. Ill publish release notes and monitor console parse errors. Draft: https://confluence/release/rdw-2026-03-23 (will publish after canary green).

cheng: ack. Ill run runtime canary and kernel selection. Proposed canary sizes: runtime 5% (10 instances), api 3% (3 instances), router header-split 1% then 10% after stability window.

sam: oncall for window. Backup is cheng. Rollback owner is alex. Pager enabled.

alex: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- p99 latency increase > 120ms above baseline sustained for 10m AND error rate > 0.5% OR
- 5xx rate > 1% for 5m OR
- console schema parse errors > 1% of requests after migration.
If triggered, rollback order: runtime -> api -> router (unsplit).

maria: add quality check: eval-suite run (opt-eval) should not regress median score >3 points. Ill post eval at +15m.

alex: Deploybot commands (dry-run verified):
```
/deploy runtime --tag v2.4.1 --canary 5 --watch 1800 --pin-tag console_schema=3.2.0
/deploy api --tag v1.8.0 --canary 3 --watch 1200
/deploy router --feature header-split --percent 1 --watch 1200
```
deploy-bot: Commands accepted. Scheduling runtime canary for 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Ill post updates here.

maria: Ill push final release blurb 10m before start. Include the console schema migration note.

cheng: Compatibility note: runtime v2.4.1 needs kernel flag `enable_fast_attn=true` on G5 nodes. Ill verify node pools and hold per-pool if missing.

sam: Ops checklist: quiesce non-critical background jobs at 22:50 UTC; increase logs retention to 7d for the window; pin emergency rollback runbook to this thread.

alex: Release notes snippet for publication: "Runtime v2.4.1: attention kernel and KV cache fixes; API v1.8.0: minor tool-calling compatibility; Console 3.2.0: schema pin to prevent parsing regressions; Router: header-split gated rollout."

maria: published release notes: https://confluence/release/rdw-2026-03-23/notes (internal+external sections ready).

cheng: will run a smoke (`curl /health` + synthetic prompt) after runtime canary warms. Expect ~5-8m warmup.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started on pool g5-canary-1 (10 instances). Canary id: cb-1768705432-rt. Metrics will follow in 5m.

alex: Monitoring dashboards: runtime-latency-p99, api-5xx-rate, console-parse-errors, router-header-split-errors. Also watch token batching cost.

maria: kicked eval: `opt-eval --suite canary-core-10k --model runtime:v2.4.1`. ETA ~12m.

sam: oncall reachable. Will escalate to infra if anything odd.

cheng: initial smoke: /health OK, p50/p90 reasonable. Waiting for full metric window.

deploy-bot: runtime canary 5m metrics: p99 +10ms, 5xx=0.03%, cpu within baseline. No console parse errors observed.

alex: Good to proceed. Hold until runtime 20m stable then start API canary.

maria: eval results posted: median delta -0.7 (within threshold). Canary OK from quality side.

deploy-bot: api canary started on pool api-canary-2 (3 instances). Canary id: cb-1768705432-api.

cheng: Router header-split initiated at 1%. Watch routing logs for any Splunk alerts.

deploy-bot: Canaries stable. Router promoted to 25% after 20m, then scheduled ramp to full on continued stability.

sam: final steps: confirm logs retention, link release notes in ticket RDW-2026-03-23, and add rollback label to PRs. After 2h stabilization mark release complete.

alex: If rollback needed use: `/rollback runtime --tag v2.4.0`. Follow rollback playbook pinned here.

cheng: Ill have rollback commands ready in terminal.

maria: tagging release ticket RDW-2026-03-23 with this thread, closing monitoring loop. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Release state: in-progress. Will post final completion timestamp after stabilization window.

alex: Closing coordination thread. Will announce final release-complete timestamp. Nice work team.
